title: Last Round
caption: Three-act finale, starting as a quiet wordless hymn for two voices over tape hiss, becoming a pounding electro track when a raw buzzing sawtooth bass and a four-on-the-floor kick crash in, and ending as a blown-out triumphant brass fanfare with chopped vocal shouts over everything. One long climb with no way back down, the distortion increasing section by section until the final chorus is clipping. Cathartic, huge, closing-credits energy.
